hints.title: Connected Water Components
hints.text: Every continuous region of adjacent water cells forms a connected component that can be fully gathered.

hints.title: Component Summation
hints.text: The total fish obtainable from any water starting cell equals the sum of all cell values in that connected component.

hints.title: Avoid Revisiting Components
hints.text: Mark visited water cells as zero or track them in a set to sum each component exactly once.

hints.title: Grid Component Flood Implementation

complexity.notes: Each grid cell is visited a constant number of times during component exploration.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-exploring components repeatedly without marking visited nodes causes infinite recursion or TLE.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m * n) call stack space in worst case.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies standard connected component exploration with grid boundary checks.
